title: Phase 5 — 결과 분석
summary: Per-phase plan for analyzing raw results to judge whether PQ hybrid downgrade is a single library bug or a general cross-implementation pattern.
notes: Prose+checklist per-phase plan (목표/할 일/산출물/완료 기준). No frontmatter type, no Decision/Consequences, no user stories, no API/schema — clearly DOC, but no filename/frontmatter convention so confidence is medium not high. source_hash in filename is a best-effort deterministic suffix; this classifier agent has no Bash tool to compute true SHA-256, and this slug is unique so no sibling collision risk.
